name: NCIS: Los Angeles
description: The exploits of the Los Angeles–based Office of Special Projects (OSP), an elite division of the Naval Criminal Investigative Service that specializes in undercover assignments.

videos.title: A Salute to NCIS: Los Angeles
videos.overview: The one-hour special features footage and interviews with NCIS: LOS ANGELES cast members from the past 14 years, including current exclusive interviews, favorite memories and behind-the-scenes moments from the ENTERTAINMENT TONIGHT vault.

videos.title: Identity
videos.overview: Callen returns back to the NCIS Office of Special Projects to solve a kidnapping case.

videos.title: The Only Easy Day
videos.overview: A case involving the murder of a drug dealer turns personal for Special Agent Sam Hanna when he discovers his former Navy Seal comrades are involved.

videos.title: Predator
videos.overview: The team is assigned to track down a missing unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) after it is compromised during a training exercise killing a marine before it disappears.

videos.title: Search and Destroy
videos.overview: The NCIS team searches Los Angeles for the lead suspect of a murdered Iraqi businessman, a former Marine who had been hired by a private security firm to protect him.

videos.title: Killshot
videos.overview: When a United States citizen of North Korean descent is murdered, the secrets to classified software are thought to be lost until NCIS uncovers a suspect from Director Vance's past.

videos.title: Keepin' It Real
videos.overview: The NCIS team must find a motive when they discover the body of a marine who had been living a double life as a wealthy bachelor.

videos.title: Pushback
videos.overview: Following the murder of a Russian woman, the NCIS team uncovers evidence that answers who and why Callen was shot six months ago.

videos.title: Ambush
videos.overview: While Hetty is attending a Senate hearing in D.C., the investigation of a murdered Marine Lance Corporal leads the NCIS team to stolen anti-tank missiles and a dangerous militia group.

videos.title: Random on Purpose
videos.overview: Forensic scientist Abby Sciuto joins the Los Angeles NCIS team when a murder case resembles the pattern for a serial killer she has been tracking.

videos.title: Brimstone
videos.overview: As the courtyard is being transformed with holiday decorations, the NCIS team races to solve the murder of a Marine by an exploding cell phone and to find the remaining men of his former EOD (explosive ordnance disposal) unit before another deadly explosion kills someone else.

videos.title: Breach
videos.overview: The death of a Petty Officer leads the NCIS team to a teenager in Sam's life. Meanwhile, Hetty is concerned about the effect that the workload is having on the team.

videos.title: Past Lives
videos.overview: The murder of a recently released convict forces Callen to go undercover solo as an old alias, while Sam and the LA team track him from a distance.

videos.title: Missing
videos.overview: The team rushes to a crime scene after receiving an "agent needs assistance" page and learns that one of their own is in peril.

videos.title: LD50
videos.overview: A crime scene poses a national security risk when the LA team discovers the location was used to create a deadly toxin which is now missing.

videos.title: The Bank Job
videos.overview: While opening a safety deposit box at a local bank, NCIS Special Agent Kensi Blye is shot after three armed assailants enter and hold everyone in the building hostage.

videos.title: Chinatown
videos.overview: The death of a lieutenant commander appears to be suicide but the NCIS team uncovers evidence corresponding to murder. Also, Operational Psychologist Nate Getz joins Special Agent Kensi Blye in the field.

videos.title: Full Throttle
videos.overview: After a sailor is killed during an underground street race, the NCIS team determines that his car had been sabotaged and contained confidential Navy equipment. Meanwhile, Callen is forced to take traffic school.

videos.title: Blood Brothers
videos.overview: The investigation of a drive-by shooting has the NCIS team searching Los Angeles for the dead marine's younger brother who may be the next target and the one with the answers.

videos.title: Hand-to-Hand
videos.overview: When an undercover operation has the NCIS team investigating a MMA gym and its fighters, Sam Hanna is tasked with donning gloves and entering the cage for a one-on-one fight.

videos.title: Fame
videos.overview: NCIS investigates the murder of a Navy officer entangled in the world of Hollywood glitz and glamour as the team is joined at Hetty's request by LAPD liaison Marty Deeks.

videos.title: Found
videos.overview: The NCIS team races to save one of their own when they receive video evidence of Special Agent Dominic Vail being held hostage months after he was kidnapped.

videos.title: Hunted
videos.overview: The NCIS team is on the hunt for a terrorist who escaped Army custody during a secretive transfer in Los Angeles.

videos.title: Burned
videos.overview: After Callen's cover is blown and compromises the unit, the NCIS team races to find out who is behind the security breach.

videos.title: Callen, G
videos.overview: Callen races against a ruthless adversary to locate a woman who knows the whereabouts of a forgotten fortune earmarked to fund a new war in the Middle East - and also holds the tantalizing key to his unknown past.

videos.title: Human Traffic
videos.overview: When one of their own disappears while undercover, the team must work alongside LAPD on a case involving human-trafficking, money laundering and drugs.

videos.title: Black Widow
videos.overview: After a mysterious hit squad takes out a Special Agent on assignment, the NCIS team jumps into action before the next target is set.

videos.title: Borderline
videos.overview: The NCIS team jumps into action when video surveillance footage shows an ambush on a humvee transporting Marines in the desert. Meanwhile, Nate returns from his mystery assignment.

videos.title: Special Delivery
videos.overview: The team investigates the murder of a Marine who had top-level security clearance, and the corpse is missing a hand.

videos.title: Little Angels
videos.overview: The team races against time to save a Naval Commander's daughter after seeing a video of her being buried alive.

videos.title: Standoff
videos.overview: Callen's ex-partner (Marisol Nichols) takes a Navy recruitment center hostage.

videos.title: Anonymous
videos.overview: After terrorists kill a state department employee and a plastic surgeon, the team searches for the only witness who can identify the killers' surgically altered faces.

videos.title: Bounty
videos.overview: Wanted terrorists and top secret information are all involved in NCIS's investigation into the kidnapping and murder of a retired army Sergeant.

videos.title: Absolution (1)
videos.overview: When a murdered antiques dealer's book of top-secret information goes missing, Hetty sends the NCIS team on a mission to find it.

videos.title: Deliverance (2)
videos.overview: Hetty and the NCIS team continue to search for an elusive book that has the attention of several foreign security agencies.

videos.title: Disorder
videos.overview: Kensi connects personally with a discharged Navy Intelligence officer suffering from post traumatic stress disorder who is the sole survivor of a deadly dispute being investigated by the NCIS team.

videos.title: Overwatch
videos.overview: The NCIS team uncovers an experimental Navy tracking system when a body containing a top-secret residue is stolen from an autopsy room. Meanwhile, Callen challenges Hetty on the rock wall.

videos.title: Archangel
videos.overview: The team looks for the person responsible when classified pentagon documents are uploaded to a blog site.

videos.title: Lockup
videos.overview: Sam goes undercover as a prisoner to track down a terrorist group responsible for several bombings around the world.

videos.title: Tin Soldiers
videos.overview: After Callen catches a man breaking into his house, a former KGB operative leads the NCIS team to a shipment of counterfeit computer chips entering the United States.

videos.title: Empty Quiver
videos.overview: Suspicious of an undercover venture involving a deal between corrupt cops and military personnel, Callen and Sam try to expose the illegal operation by posing as California highway patrol officers.

videos.title: Personal
videos.overview: Deeks' morning routine is disrupted when he is shot during a convenience store robbery, leaving the NCIS team to investigate whether he was the assailants' intended target.

videos.title: Harm's Way
videos.overview: Sam resumes a former alias and boards a one-way flight to Yemen in hopes of tracking down a terrorist group's leader and rescuing the hostage son of a Saudi Prince.

videos.title: Enemy Within
videos.overview: NCIS investigates whether the life of a Venezuelan politician is in danger after a Navy Intelligence Commander who is responsible for tracking his moves suddenly disappears.

videos.title: The Job
videos.overview: When an attempted robbery takes place at a secure facility on a Marine base, Kensi must determine what the thief intended to steal.

videos.title: Rocket Man
videos.overview: After a rocket engine expert is killed, NCIS tech operator Eric Beale goes undercover for the first time to ensure that the classified technology used to build satellites is safe.

videos.title: Plan B
videos.overview: Deeks resumes an old alias he is not fond of in order to protect his best friend and chief informant from a criminal group that wants him dead.

videos.title: Imposters
videos.overview: A Navy SEAL imposter's death gives the team a lead on a missing canister used to make deadly bombs.

videos.title: Familia
videos.overview: Hetty's sudden resignation prompts Callen and the NCIS team to investigate the reason why she would disappear in the hopes of tracking her down.

videos.title: Lange, H.
videos.overview: The Special Projects team travels to Romania to search for Hetty, while delving into the history of the Comescu crime family, and their connection to Callen.

videos.title: Cyber Threat
videos.overview: The NCIS team joins forces with the NSA to find the creator and controller of a software program linked to a cyber attack against the Department of Defense. Meanwhile, Callen continues searching for more information about his past.

videos.title: Backstopped
videos.overview: Special Agent Sam Hanna is sent undercover as a bomb specialist as the team races to locate stolen explosives somewhere in the city. Meanwhile, to much protest, Hunter changes the dynamics of the team and has Callen partnered with Kensi and Sam with Deeks.

videos.title: Deadline
videos.overview: The NCIS team delves into the underground world of the Libyan resistance movement following the murder of a news reporter, and Hetty reveals details about Callen’s past.

videos.title: Sacrifice
videos.overview: The LAPD calls upon the NCIS team when a raid links a Mexican drug cartel to a wanted terrorist. Meanwhile, Sam’s most prized possession is stolen.

videos.title: Lone Wolf
videos.overview: The NCIS team investigates the murder of a former Navy intelligence officer who had been living a double life and traveling overseas on false passports.

videos.title: Honor
videos.overview: The NCIS team must determine whether a dishonorably discharged Marine is the target of an international set-up or if he committed murder

videos.title: Greed
videos.overview: When a Navy ID is found on a dead body tied to a hazardous material smuggling case, NCIS is granted permission to investigate in Mexico and asked to help locate the missing materials.

videos.title: Betrayal
videos.overview: After Sam’s undercover mission in Sudan turns deadly, Callen and the NCIS team must track down their missing agent before it is too late.

videos.title: The Debt
videos.overview: A botched assignment forces Hetty to fire Deeks and send him back to the LAPD. Meanwhile, an awkward goodbye between Kensi and Deeks leaves her with unexpected emotions for her old partner

videos.title: Higher Power
videos.overview: The NCIS team must locate a classified device with the power to destroy Los Angeles that was stolen from a college research facility. Meanwhile, Sam tries to track down a highly sought-after Christmas present for his daughter, and Eric meets Nell’s parents.

videos.title: The Watchers
videos.overview: A new Assistant Director is assigned to oversee LA operations for NCIS, the team begins to wonder what his intentions really are.

videos.title: Exit Strategy
videos.overview: When a vehicle transporting Jada Khaled is ambushed, NCIS must track down the culprit to save her and their case. Meanwhile, Sam is forced to confront Jada for the first time since returning from Sudan.

videos.title: Partners
videos.overview: After a diplomatic service van transporting an unknown package from the State Department is hijacked, the NCIS team must determine who committed the crime and what has gone missing. Meanwhile, Callen and Sam celebrate five years as partners, but face one of their biggest challenges when they go undercover for a case.

videos.title: Crimeleon
videos.overview: With Assistant Director Granger critiquing every move, the NCIS team must track down a chameleon-like killer who has evaded law enforcement agents, including their very own Special Agent G. Callen, across several countries.

videos.title: Blye, K. (1)
videos.overview: The team searches for new evidence to prove Kensi Blye’s innocence after she is taken into custody as the lead suspect in a murder investigation involving her deceased father’s sniper unit.

videos.title: Blye, K. (2)
videos.overview: The NCIS: LA team continues to search for new evidence to prove Kensi Blye’s innocence after a private meeting involving her deceased father’s sniper unit turns deadly.

videos.title: The Dragon and the Fairy
videos.overview: The NCIS: LA team investigates a shooting outside the Vietnamese Consulate just prior to an international conference at the venue that the Secretary of the Navy is scheduled to attend.

videos.title: Vengeance
videos.overview: When the body of a Navy Intel Officer is found, evidence points to a team of Navy SEALs who are about to depart on a hostage rescue mission, leaving former Navy SEAL Sam Hanna to interrogate the group and possibly compromise the mission.

videos.title: Patriot Acts
videos.overview: When a former Marine is suspected of creating a chemical bomb, the NCIS: LA team joins the FBI’s domestic terrorist task force including Operational Psychologist Nate Getz.

videos.title: Touch of Death (II)
videos.overview:
The joint NCIS: Los Angeles and Hawaii Five-0 task force travel from Hawaii to Los Angeles, when the lead suspect in the case moves to the mainland with a deadly virus in tow.

The crossover starts on Hawaii Five-0 S02E21 Pa Make Loa (Touch of Death) (I).

videos.title: Neighborhood Watch
videos.overview: Kensi and Deeks are sent undercover as married couple Melissa and Justin when evidence points to a Russian sleeper cell in a suburban neighborhood.

videos.title: Sans Voir (1)
videos.overview: Callen and the NCIS: LA team confront their vengeful adversary, the Chameleon, when an undercover case ignites a deadly mind game orchestrated by the criminal mastermind.

videos.title: Sans Voir (2)
videos.overview: The L.A. team is drawn into a deadly mind game against a master criminal motivated by Revenge.

videos.title: Endgame
videos.overview: Following Callen’s public shooting of the Chameleon, all is not well with the NCIS: LA team, as Callen is placed on suspension and Hetty adjusts to retired life.

videos.title: Recruit
videos.overview: A drone strike on a bomb-making compound in Afghanistan reveals the body of a recently retired Marine, leaving the NCIS: LA team to investigate why the Marine returned to Afghanistan and whether or not he betrayed the country he fought for.

videos.title: The Fifth Man
videos.overview: The NCIS: LA team investigate a compromised intel operation after four people connected to the classified project are killed at a diner explosion. As Deeks and Kensi are on the trail of those involved, they learn that a wayward teenage girl might be related and Kensi can’t help but be empathetic to her situation.

videos.title: Dead Body Politic
videos.overview: The NCIS: LA team investigates the tragic death of a U.S. senatorial candidate’s staffer who is run over crossing the street. The high-profile case becomes a matter of national security as the agents must determine whether it is an isolated tragic incident or a politically connected plot that might put others in danger.

videos.title: Out of the Past (1)
videos.overview: When a CIA agent who worked with Sam Hanna over eight years ago seeks his help and is soon found dead of an apparent suicide, Hanna and Callen suspect foul play and a bigger conspiracy. Meanwhile, Deeks finds his inner “dog whisperer” with Kensi as the two go undercover and enter a dog show with a prized poodle.

videos.title: Rude Awakenings (2)
videos.overview: The NCIS: LA team continues their investigation behind the death of a CIA agent that leads to a dangerous ring of Russian super agents. In a race against time, Hanna risks having a secret exposed.

videos.title: Skin Deep
videos.overview: The NCIS: LA team heads to the beach to question the possible link between a surfer, an Internet video and a dead Naval tech scientist. Meanwhile, as Callen and Hanna investigate the victim’s intelligence connections, Deeks and Kensi go undercover to catch their suspects and some waves.

videos.title: Collateral
videos.overview: The NCIS: LA team questions the motive behind the murder of a retired CIA agent turned millionaire and in the process also questions what Hetty knows about the case.

videos.title: The Gold Standard
videos.overview: The NCIS: Los Angeles team investigates the strange and brazen heist executed by gunmen in costumes that could directly impact the U.S. economy. Meanwhile, as Deeks testifies on a case, Granger insists on partnering up with a very reluctant Kensi.

videos.title: Free Ride
videos.overview: Callen, Sam, Kensi and Deeks spend Christmas aboard an aircraft carrier investigating the death of a fellow NCIS special agent. Meanwhile, Nell and Eric make the most of the holidays back at headquarters and Hetty takes a trip.

videos.title: Drive
videos.overview: A former defendant of Deeks is targeted for discovering information that could dismantle a lucrative car shipping operation with links to a global terrorist ring. Meanwhile, the NCIS: LA team tackles the large-scale stolen car operation from the inside when Kensi goes undercover in an auto body shop.

videos.title: Paper Soldiers
videos.overview: A distraught widow is suspicious of the circumstances surrounding her Marine husband’s last battle and Sam and Callen help to determine if there has been a cover-up. Meanwhile, Hetty summons Operational Psychologist Nate Getz to be her “pawn” and the rest of the NCIS: LA sense another evaluation on the horizon.

videos.title: The Chosen One
videos.overview: Callen goes undercover to infiltrate a network of Chechen terrorists who are recruiting foreign fighters to join their cause and planning their next attack in the U.S.

videos.title: Kill House
videos.overview: Callen, Sam, Kensi and Deeks go undercover as an elite tactical force in order to investigate an ambush tied to a cartel kingpin with terrorist connections.

videos.title: History
videos.overview: An NCIS: LA investigation leads the team to question a lone survivor of a former terrorist organization, while Kensi and Deeks follow the trail into the woods

videos.title: Lohkay
videos.overview: Callen is concerned that Sam might be too invested after he takes on a missing persons case for an Afghani elder who helped him years ago when he was wounded on a mission.

videos.title: Wanted
videos.overview: Sam fears for his family’s safety when his wife is called to resume a former CIA cover after a case suggests ties to the infamous Sidorov and his stolen nuke.

videos.title: Red (1)
videos.overview: Callen and Sam fly to Idaho and join forces with NCIS: Red, a mobile team of agents who live together and investigate crimes in various locations, when a murder weapon found there matches one used in a national security case in Los Angeles.

videos.title: Red (2)
videos.overview: While the LA team chases leads digitally and locally, the NCIS: Red team travels in their mobile trucks, nicknamed "Laverne and Shirley", in a race to track down a cunning terrorist before he disappears.

videos.title: Purity
videos.overview: When cyanide in a communal water jug lethally poisons a lieutenant and leaves a Navy pilot in serious condition, the NCIS: LA team investigates whether this is an isolated incident or an early test for large-scale water contamination.

videos.title: Resurrection
videos.overview: A body is stolen after a special task force successfully takes down an infamous cartel boss, leaving the NCIS: LA team to investigate the leak and track down the missing body.

videos.title: Raven & the Swans
videos.overview: Callen questions Hetty’s motivations when a bizarre case involving a mysterious woman is revealed to be an undercover agent from her past.

videos.title: Parley
videos.overview: Deeks goes undercover to obtain information about an infamous arms dealer looking to get back in the business, but the woman he befriends leads the operation in a dangerous directon. Meanwhile, Kensi confronts new emotions as she runs surveillance on Deeks and his female source.

videos.title: Descent
videos.overview: A nuclear explosion in the Pacific reignites the search for stolen nuclear weapons and prompts Hetty to shuffle the NCIS: LA partnerships, sending Callen and Kensi overseas and leaving Sam and Deeks teamed up state side.

videos.title: Ascension
videos.overview: While Sam and Deeks recover from traumatic torture that will have a lasting impact on their personal and professional relationships, lives are still in jeopardy as the NCIS: LA team searches for stolen nuclear weapons.

videos.title: Impact
videos.overview: In an effort to help Sam and Deeks return to work, Hetty calls upon Operational Psychologist Nate Getz to help them cope with their traumatic experience. Meanwhile, the rest of the NCIS: LA team investigates the murder of a former Navy Admiral and a controversial journalist aboard a private jet.

videos.title: Omni
videos.overview: The NCIS: LA team must find who compromised a classified vaccine project from a bio tech company. Meanwhile, Deeks struggles with his emotions upon returning to the field.

videos.title: Reznikov, N.
videos.overview: The NCIS: LA team finds themselves in danger while investigating a kidnapping case of a man claiming to be Callen’s father.

videos.title: Unwritten Rule
videos.overview: Analyst Nell Jones joins the NCIS: LA team in the field when a former Navy officer’s girlfriend is kidnapped in exchange for Navy intelligence. Meanwhile, Deeks unknowingly breaks one of Hetty’s rules.

videos.title: Big Brother
videos.overview: When a 15-year-old hacker compromises missions, Callen goes under cover at a prestigious high school.

videos.title: The Livelong Day
videos.overview: The team must alert Homeland Security when they uncover a threat to a Los Angeles-based train during a murder investigation.

videos.title: Fallout
videos.overview: The team must locate and retrieve a stolen antiterrorism device before the city is attacked; Hetty is haunted by her past.

videos.title: Recovery
videos.overview: Kensi goes undercover as a nutritionist and Deeks poses as a new patient at a rehab center to investigate the death of a Navy officer.

videos.title: The Frozen Lake
videos.overview: Callen and Sam enlist the help of a Gurkha, an elite Nepali soldier specializing in knife fighting, to retrieve a missing thumb drive.  Meanwhile, Kensi and Deeks struggle to find a balance in their partnership.

videos.title: Iron Curtain Rising
videos.overview: When a former Romanian Communist leader and suspected war criminal is discovered to be living in Los Angeles under a false identity, the NCIS: LA team must locate him before he disappears again.

videos.title: Merry Evasion
videos.overview: A senator’s daughter is the victim of a home invasion. The team investigate to determine if it was a random crime or a targeted attack due to her father’s crackdown on international cyber warfare. Meanwhile, Kensi’s holiday spirit changes after she receives a surprise Christmas gift.

videos.title: Allegiance
videos.overview: While in Afghanistan, Kensi and Granger join the team on a joint case when a federal agent in Los Angeles tied to Hawala, an ancient system of money transfer, is murdered.

videos.title: War Cries
videos.overview: The investigation into the murder of two private military contractors ends up putting a member of the team in grave danger; Sam arranges a blind date for Callen.

videos.title: Tuhon
videos.overview: Callen and Sam search for a murder suspect -- a retired assassin (Danny Trejo) they encountered on their first case together.

videos.title: Fish Out of Water
videos.overview: Following an explosion at a fish market, the NCIS: LA team partners with an undercover DEA agent to determine if the incident is an act of terrorism or a botched drug smuggling deal. Meanwhile, in Afghanistan, Granger and Kensi investigate a helicopter crash that could be tied to their ongoing search for the infamous white ghost.

videos.title: Between the Lines
videos.overview: When a gang identifies and executes an undercover agent, the team must locate a mole before other agents are put in danger.

videos.title: Zero Days
videos.overview: Eric witnesses his friend, a computer systems expert, being attacked by people who want information that could redirect a missile; Kensi runs into a familiar face in Afghanistan.

videos.title: Spoils of War
videos.overview: After learning that Special Agent Kensi Blye disappeared and the Taliban may be he holding her captive, Hetty sends the NCIS: LA team to Afghanistan on a rescue mission.

videos.title: Windfall
videos.overview: Nell joins Deeks in the field on a case involving a former Marine who is being tracked by al-Qaida after embezzling money from Iraq.

videos.title: Three Hearts
videos.overview: The team takes an undercover agent who is suspected of working for the smuggler he is supposed to be investigating into custody; Kensi and Deeks discuss their relationship.

videos.title: One More Chance
videos.overview: Sam is convinced that the theft of software for a new unmanned aerial vehicle is connected with the disappearance of the lead engineer's 10-year-old daughter, a girl Sam once provided protection detail for in Saudi Arabia.

videos.title: Exposure
videos.overview: When a news reporter announces the group responsible for the deadly explosion at a military-sponsored charity event, the team must investigate her claims and search for the attacker.

videos.title: Deep Trouble (1)
videos.overview: When the NCIS: Los Angeles team and DEA uncover the cartel's plans to slyly transport billions of dollars’ worth of cocaine from Colombia to the U.S. using a submarine, Callen and Sam must quickly locate the missing vessel. Meanwhile, Hetty is called to Washington in the aftermath of the controversial mission in Afghanistan.

videos.title: Deep Trouble (2)
videos.overview: Callen and Sam find themselves trapped inside an armed submarine that terrorists are intending to use to hit an aircraft carrier in San Diego. Hetty goes against orders and forgoes her trip to Washington, as the team attempt  to locate and save Callen and Sam and stop the terrorist attack.

videos.title: Inelegant Heart
videos.overview: The NCIS: LA team find out that one of their own has been compromised as they investigate the murder of a Navy contractor involved in illegal transactions of confidential data.

videos.title: Praesidium
videos.overview: The Department of Justice target a member of the team. Leon delivers unsettling news to Hetty.

videos.title: The 3rd Choir
videos.overview: The team learns that someone from their past is targeting one of their own. Nate Getz attempts to help Nell get through a traumatic experience.

videos.title: Black Budget
videos.overview: Callen and Sam make their way to Mexico to locate the only employee who escaped a professional hit at the Department of Defense. Back in America, the rest of the team work to discover the motive behind the shooting.

videos.title: SEAL Hunter
videos.overview: Sam is arrested accused of murdering a woman and Callen and Granger attempt to clear his name.

videos.title: Leipei
videos.overview: A man is murdered by a small drone, so the team suspect a terrorist group is responsible. Nell attempts avoiding disaster at Long Beach.

videos.title: The Grey Man
videos.overview: After Deeks and Kensi work under cover to investigate the murder of a homeless man they discover a connection to a Mexican cartel.

videos.title: Traitor
videos.overview: Eric is one of seven suspects after Granger is poisoned by the mole.

videos.title: Reign Fall
videos.overview: The team become involved in an investigation into the murders of Marines whose sons are at military academics.

videos.title: Humbug
videos.overview: The team take a look at a burglary at a cyber-security company, and Callen has to steer clear after Hetty reveals that his girlfriend, Joelle, is one of the main witnesses.

videos.title: Spiral
videos.overview: The team investigate an arms dealer but are interrupted as the suspect's building is overrun by terrorists.

videos.title: In the Line of Duty
videos.overview: Sam and Callen need to get their hands on some key evidence after a U.S. Ambassador survives a terrorist attack.

videos.title: Black Wind
videos.overview: Looking for the person responsible for an anthrax poisoning, Sam and Callen work under cover as food truck owners.

videos.title: Forest for the Trees
videos.overview: Callen and Sam end up being abducted during the follow up of an anonymous tip about a missing NSA agent.

videos.title: Expiration Date
videos.overview: After Sam is shot by a spy contracted by the CIA the team need the help of a Nepali soldier.

videos.title: Savoir Faire
videos.overview: Members of the team take a look into the death of an Afghan soldier training in America.

videos.title: Fighting Shadows
videos.overview: Following a successful sting, an explosion causes three FBI agents to be killed.

videos.title: Blaze of Glory
videos.overview: When a missile test is hijacked and sent off course, the team searches for the hacking group responsible for the attack with the help of a young computer specialist Hetty brings in to assist the team.  Also, Nell sees the bond between the tech guru and Eric and she becomes jealous.Source: CBS

videos.title: Rage
videos.overview: Callen and Sam resume their undercover identities as a prisoner and guard to infiltrate a white supremacist group believed to be in possession of stolen nuclear material, while  Kensi transforms herself into a tattooed biker to play the part of Callen’s girlfriend.  Also, Callen’s first meeting with Hetty is revealed.Source: CBS

videos.title: Beacon
videos.overview: Callen and Sam are shocked when an old acquaintance, who they thought was the recent victim of a murder, appears and asks for their help. As the team investigates, they uncover a possible breach of America's economic sanctions against Russia.Source: CBS

videos.title: Field of Fire
videos.overview: The team attempt to find an expert sniper after they learn about his connection to an extremist group.

videos.title: Kolcheck, A.
videos.overview: Some presumed dead crew members show up from the missing tanker that was involved in Arkady's deal with Russia.

videos.title: Chernoff, K.
videos.overview: Some of the team have to assume undercover identities in Moscow so that they can locate their suspects.

videos.title: Active Measures
videos.overview: Callen embarks on a secret project, leaving Sam and the entire team in the dark. After Hetty demands his operation be shut down, the team is tasked with locating Callen before he finds himself in over his head.

videos.title: Citadel
videos.overview: DEA agent Talia Del Campo turns to the NCIS: Los Angeles team for help after her partner is murdered. Also, after Kensi grows suspicious that Deeks is hiding something, he surprises her by introducing her to his mother.

videos.title: Driving Miss Diaz
videos.overview: A 20-year-old Peruvian massacre is investigated after a famous fashion model, believed to be one of the survivors, becomes a potential target. Kensi goes undercover as the model's assistant, while Deeks poses as her chauffeur.

videos.title: Command & Control
videos.overview: Callen and Sam are forced to work on their day off when they mysteriously receive a cell phone and the caller threatens the lives of innocent people if they don’t do exactly what he says.

videos.title: Blame It on Rio
videos.overview: NCIS Special Agent DiNozzo partners with the NCIS: Los Angeles team to search the city after his prisoner escapes custody on a flight from Singapore to Los Angeles.

videos.title: Unspoken
videos.overview: The NCIS team searches for Sam’s former partner, Ruiz, who disappears during an undercover operation to buy a deadly explosive.

videos.title: An Unlocked Mind
videos.overview: After a former Department of Defense employee reveals government secrets to a cult, The Church of the Unlocked Mind, Kensi and Deeks go undercover in order to protect him. Meanwhile, the team must prevent the church from selling the secrets to a Chinese spy.

videos.title: The Long Goodbye
videos.overview: The team searches for Jada (Ella Thomas), the woman Sam led to asylum in the United States four years ago, after she goes missing. Also, Kensi goes undercover with DEA Agent Talia Del Campo (Mercedes Mason).

videos.title: Defectors
videos.overview: The team searches for a missing teenage girl who is feared to have been recruited by a terrorist organization,

videos.title: Internal Affairs
videos.overview: Deeks is arrested and interrogated in connection with the murder of his former partner, while the team tries to prove his innocence.

videos.title: Cancel Christmas
videos.overview: When a suspected North Korean spy is poisoned and hit by a truck carrying Christmas trees, the team must search for who is responsible for smuggling spies into the country. Also, Deeks and Kensi try to find a way to include their mothers in their Christmas plans, and Hetty notices that Granger isn’t feeling the holiday cheer.

videos.title: Core Values
videos.overview: Kensi and Deeks go undercover at a decommissioned nuclear power plant as the team investigates the radiation poisoning of a Gunnery Sergeant moonlighting as a security guard there.

videos.title: Angels & Daemons
videos.overview: The team investigates the murder of tech entrepreneur turned venture capitalist who secretly developed a daemon, a background computer program that allows for undetectable data collection.

videos.title: Come Back
videos.overview: When Kensi and Deeks announce to the team they are moving in together, coincidentally, Hetty assigns them to protection detail for Jack, Kensi’s ex-fiancé, who is in possession of a list containing important contacts in Afghanistan that people are willing to kill to get their hands on.

videos.title: Matryoshka (1)
videos.overview: In order to locate Arkady in Russia, the NCIS team goes undercover with his daughter, Anna, at a gala in Los Angeles to gain access to the Russian Consul General’s computer.

videos.title: Matryoshka, Part 2
videos.overview: While they’re in Russia, Callen, Sam and Anna craft a plan to break Anna’s father and his CIA agent companion out of prison. Also, Special Agent G. Callen finally learns what the “G” in his name stands for, and in Los Angeles, Kensi and Deeks take Eric into the field on an assignment.

videos.title: Revenge Deferred
videos.overview: After extensive surveillance footage of Sam’s family is found in Africa, Sam and Callen fly there to determine who is responsible and for what purpose. Also, Sam’s family is moved from their home to a safe house.

videos.title: Exchange Rate
videos.overview: When a convicted Cuban spy escapes U.S. custody just before he is set to return to his country in a prisoner exchange, the team is shocked to learn that Anna helped him break out. Also, Deeks admits to Kensi that he thinks she is too messy.

videos.title: The Seventh Child
videos.overview: Callen and the team try to save a child in imminent danger who has been brainwashed by a terrorist cell. Also, Deeks and Kensi discuss having children.

videos.title: Seoul Man
videos.overview: While assigned to protective details for the commander of the Pacific Command, the team searches for a North Korean spy.

videos.title: Head of the Snake
videos.overview: After Operational Psychologist Nate Getz fails to check in with Hetty while working undercover on a mission linking organized crime to terrorism, the team learns he is working with an infamous crime leader,

videos.title: Granger, O.
videos.overview: As Granger escorts Jennifer Kim back to Los Angeles, he interrogates her regarding a North Korean spy and she admits to knowing he is her father.

videos.title: Where There's Smoke...
videos.overview: Sam and Callen go undercover as firefighters when top secret information about suspected terrorists is stolen from a secure Department of Defense container at the site of a fire.

videos.title: Talion
videos.overview: Sam receives a distress code from Aiden saying that his school is being taken over by an extremist group.

videos.title: High-Value Target (1)
videos.overview: After NCIS fails to locate a mole in the department, Under Secretary of Defense Corbin Duggan insists on new leadership and takes over the Los Angeles unit from Hetty and Granger.

videos.title: Belly of the Beast (2)
videos.overview: The team travels to Syria to apprehend a High Value Target where one team member is severely injured when the mission goes awry.

videos.title: The Queen's Gambit
videos.overview: The NCIS LA team investigates an abduction case while down two members, with Hetty being held in D.C. for questioning, and another still in the ICU following the mission in Syria.

videos.title: Black Market
videos.overview: After a Homeland Security agent is poisoned by a notorious Triad assassin, NCIS uncovers a warehouse of counterfeit purses and a money trail to stolen government funds. Also, Nell joins the team in the field.

videos.title: Ghost Gun
videos.overview: The murder of a navy machinist with high security clearance sends the team on a city-wide hunt tracking evidence. Also, Anna Kolcheck partners with Callen, and Sam assists Hetty in the on-going mole investigation.

videos.title: Home Is Where the Heart Is
videos.overview: After a maintenance man saved the life of a lieutenant commander, the NCIS team uncovers his dark past which puts a local teenager in danger. Also, Sam must decide which colleague to take to the Los Angeles football game.

videos.title: Crazy Train
videos.overview: After an NSA analyst is found eaten by a shark, the team's investigation leads them to a cartel's money-laundering scheme and sends Callen into a mental asylum to find a key witness; Kensi struggles with her therapy.

videos.title: Parallel Resistors
videos.overview: The team's investigation into the electrocution of a college student working on a classified Navy project leads them to his inquisitive daughter, who may be the key to accessing his work.

videos.title: Glasnost
videos.overview: After Callen’s father, Garrison is found in an NCIS patient’s hospital room during a radiation poisoning case, Callen must take him to the boatshed for interrogation. Also, the team discusses their Thanksgiving plans.

videos.title: Sirens
videos.overview: After an unknown female assailant kills two men disguised as Sherriff’s deputies in front of Callen’s home, the NCIS team gets a new lead in the ongoing mole investigation. Also, Nell visits a prison to interview an inmate withholding information on the department’s leak.

videos.title: Tidings We Bring
videos.overview: The team goes on the chase for a Navy analyst being held hostage, only to discover things aren't as simple as they seem.

videos.title: Kulinda
videos.overview: After a Navy reservist is killed while protecting a city councilman, Sam is sent undercover in a private security firm with links to several criminal organizations.

videos.title: Hot Water (1)
videos.overview: The mole has once again compromised the NCIS team as planted evidence results in the arrests of Callen, Sam, Granger and Deeks, on the day Under Secretary Duggan (Jackson Hurst) returns for Hetty’s resignation.

videos.title: Under Siege (2)
videos.overview: Hetty goes rogue, leaving the NCIS team completely in the dark, and the mole kidnaps one of the agents.

videos.title: Payback (3)
videos.overview: As the team races to save Kensi from Ferris/Sullivan, they find themselves questioning who they can trust when old faces resurface.

videos.title: Old Tricks
videos.overview: When a Navy lieutenant and his grandfather are kidnapped from a retirement home, the team's investigation leads them to a con artist couple and the hunt for a rare coin; Callen meanwhile has to deal with his father's actions when he kidnaps the father of his grandson (and Callen's nephew).

videos.title: Queen Pin
videos.overview: Sam resumes an old alias to bring down a major criminal kingpin; Callen and Anna's romantic night is interrupted when they are tasked with escorting a high-value prisoner to Los Angeles for questioning.

videos.title: Getaway
videos.overview: After the U.S. Treasury Department is hacked, Nell and Eric go undercover inside a couple's retreat to track a tech-savvy husband and wife linked to the crime. Also, Digital Forensics Specialist Dave Flynn (Scott Grimes) arrives from the NCIS cyber office in San Diego to run ops while Eric and Nell are on assignment.

After an engineer who was developing a new guided missile destroyer is murdered, Callen and Sam go undercover to track his co-worker aboard a plane to Tokyo to sell the classified intel. Also, Deeks plans a surprise get-together for Kensi and her out-of-town friends.

videos.title: From Havana With Love
videos.overview: The NCIS team investigates a defense contractor, Rebecca Larmont, designing a nuclear attack weapon after her estranged husband, Victor Larmont, says he has proof she is selling Navy secrets to a foreign government. Also, Kensi goes undercover as a professional dancer at the Cuban club where the husband works, while Deeks is undercover as the bathroom attendant.

videos.title: Battle Scars (1)
videos.overview: After a highly decorated Navy Captain, Charles Langston, kidnaps a Veterans Affairs administrator who has been siphoning funds, the NCIS team must work with Hetty’s former Vietnam War colleagues, now-retired Admiral AJ Chegwidden and Admiral Sterling Bridges to solve the case.

videos.title: Golden Days (2)
videos.overview: A gold heist investigation has the NCIS team working with Hetty's former Vietnam War colleagues, Retired Admiral AJ Chegwidden, Admiral Sterling Bridges and Retired Captain Charles Langston.

videos.title: Uncaged (1)
videos.overview: After Sam's wife, Michelle, is taken from her home, the kidnappers demand the prison release of Tahir Khaled, Sam's arch nemesis, in exchange for information on her whereabouts.

videos.title: Unleashed (2)
videos.overview: Following the kidnapping of Sam's wife, Michelle Hanna, Sam goes rogue from the NCIS team and attempts to stop his arch nemesis Tahir Khaled from ever targeting his family again.

videos.title: Party Crashers
videos.overview: Season 9 begins with Hetty turning in retirement papers and disappearing. A new executive director arrives and immediately makes staffing changes. Meanwhile, Sam, still mourning his wife’s death, insists that Callen find a new partner.

videos.title: Se Murio El Payaso
videos.overview: When the daughter of a notorious counterfeiter arrives in Los Angeles, Sam is sent undercover as a financier, while Callen partners with Anna to track the family's latest scheme.

videos.title: Assets
videos.overview: During the murder investigation of a Navy Lieutenant on leave in Los Angeles, the NCIS team uncovers classified surveillance briefs she smuggled into the city that may have been sold to a foreign buyer.

videos.title: Plain Sight
videos.overview: After weapons with a $1 million street value are stolen, the team tracks the evidence to a wealthy charity event, prompting Mosley to be added to the guest list with Callen and Sam as her security detail.

videos.title: Mountebank
videos.overview: Sam goes undercover as a day trader after a prominent investment banker with ties to a Russian oligarch is murdered. Meanwhile, one of Callen’s aliases is the victim of credit card theft, and Mosley is concerned it signals something bigger.

videos.title: Can I Get A Witness?
videos.overview: LAPD Detective Whiting calls in a favor when Deeks' former partner goes rogue.

videos.title: The Silo
videos.overview: Kensi is transported to a missile launch facility to help thwart a takeover of nuclear weapons.

videos.title: This Is What We Do
videos.overview: The team must find assailants who illegally crossed the border and attacked California Highway Patrol officers; Homeland Security sends Nell's older and bossy sister to assist with the case.

videos.title: Fool Me Twice
videos.overview: Callen and the team question CIA Agent Joelle Taylor's backstory after she escapes from a kidnapping and turns to Callen for help.

videos.title: Forasteira
videos.overview: The NCIS team tracks a highly skilled assailant determined to avenge her father's death by killing a Brazilian diplomat.

videos.title: All is Bright
videos.overview: The team investigates a ransomware attack that takes out the entire power grid for west L.A. and paralyzes the city. Also, as the first holiday season since the death of Sam’s wife approaches, he struggles to find the best way for his family to celebrate.

videos.title: Under Pressure
videos.overview: After napalm is detected at a crime scene, the NCIS team investigates the sole casualty for possible links to terrorism.

videos.title: Các Tù Nhân
videos.overview: While Hetty is being tortured by her captors in Vietnam, Eric and Nell find a clue to her whereabouts, prompting the team to organize a rescue mission with very little information.

videos.title: Goodbye, Vietnam
videos.overview: Callen, Sam, Kensi and Deeks join Hetty’s team from the Vietnam War, Sterling Bridges, A.J. Chegwidden and Charles Langston, in a dangerous and off-the-books rescue mission to save Hetty from her captors in Vietnam. Also, Mosley calls in Nell’s sister, homeland security specialist Sydney Jones, to assist the team in Los Angeles with processing evidence connected to Hetty’s time in Vietnam.

videos.title: Liabilities
videos.overview: Callen and Sam pull Granger’s daughter, former spy Jennifer Kim, from witness protection to help the team locate an underground spy who has obtained an arsenal of bomb materials.

videos.title: Warrior of Peace
videos.overview: Callen pursues every alternative when the Diplomatic Security Service apprehends his father, Nikita Aleksandr Reznikov, as part of an exchange for two American photographers being held hostage in Iran.

videos.title: The Monster
videos.overview: While investigating a missing person’s case, the team uncovers a killer who puts on shows for high-paying voyeurs. Also, Mosley assigns Callen as her partner on a joint ATF mission to apprehend someone from her past.

videos.title: Vendetta
videos.overview: Callen and Sam join forces with Anna Kolcheck and the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms (ATF), when Arkady Kolcheck warns NCIS that a notorious international weapons dealer has returned to the states. Also, the case requires Eric to go undercover as a bank IT technician.

videos.title: Outside the Lines
videos.overview: After a cryptocurrency farm is robbed of over $10 million in Bitcoin codes, Sam and Hidoko go undercover, with Sam resuming a likely compromised former alias.

videos.title: Reentry
videos.overview: Callen, Sam and Nell must find pieces of a failed rocket launch, including a top-secret government device; Hetty tries to help Keane acclimate to life in the states.

videos.title: Where Everybody Knows Your Name
videos.overview: NCIS partners with the FBI after a Marine is murdered by a rare nerve gas. Also, Deeks shares his dream to quit law enforcement and open a bar.

videos.title: Venganza
videos.overview: NCIS investigates the murder of a federal prison inmate who was the adopted daughter of a notorious counterfeiter. Also, Callen is summoned by the Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms (ATF) Internal Affairs board to discuss Anna Kolcheck’s actions during a joint NCIS and ATF case.

videos.title: A Line in the Sand
videos.overview: After Sam is shot during a firefight with the cartel, a suspect is interrogated and reveals new information on the whereabouts of Spencer Williams, the man who kidnapped Mosley's son five years ago.

videos.title: Ninguna Salida
videos.overview: Despite several team members having grave reservations, NCIS travels to Mexico for a risky mission to locate and rescue Mosley's son.

videos.title: To Live and Die in Mexico
videos.overview: Gravely injured and unable to communicate with the team in the U.S., Callen, Sam and Kensi, with an unconscious Deeks in tow, search for a safe way home as a cartel boss places a “dead or alive” bounty on their heads. Also, Mosely and retired Navy Admiral Hollace Kilbride beseech their contacts in Mexico and D.C. for assistance with their missing colleagues

videos.title: Superhuman
videos.overview: After the prototype for a tactical assault suit is stolen from a Navy base and used in a Beverly Hills jewelry heist, the team must determine who stole the suit and what their next target is. Also, retired Navy Admiral Hollace Kilbride temporarily oversees the team while Mosely and Hetty face repercussions for the unsanctioned Mexico mission.

videos.title: The Prince
videos.overview: Callen and Sam are assigned protection duty for Deputy Crown Prince Kamal after an unknown assassin targets his decoy upon his arrival in Los Angeles.

videos.title: Hit List
videos.overview: The NCIS team is in danger after their pictures, as well as Mosley and her son’s names, are included on a cartel hit list. Also, NCIS Deputy Director Louis Ochoa arrives with Special Prosecutor John Rogers to interview Mosley about the off-the-books mission in Mexico.

videos.title: Pro Se
videos.overview: While assisting NCIS with an undercover operation, informant Elizabeth Williams is arrested and the team is unable to provide her with an alibi. Also, Callen meets with ATF Agent Anna Kolcheck who remains on suspension following her last joint case.

videos.title: Asesinos
videos.overview: The NCIS team attempts to locate Mosley after she murders a cartel hitman and goes off the grid.

videos.title: One of Us
videos.overview: The NCIS team partners with the State Department after the murder of an arms dealer is connected to a series of crimes seemingly executed by someone with elite special forces training. Also, Callen visits ATF Agent Anna Kolcheck in prison as she awaits her sentencing.

videos.title: The Patton Project
videos.overview: Deputy Director Ochoa volunteers the NCIS team to assist with a covert operation tied to a terrorist group advocating for extreme military force. Also, Callen has concerns as to what an assignment of this nature could mean for the future of the team.

videos.title: A Diamond in the Rough
videos.overview: The NCIS team investigates the home invasion of Navy Captain Dean Hadlow, who was entertaining his friend, General Omer Abidi of Pakistan, when robbers successfully stole money, jewelry and highly classified information. Also, Deeks and Kensi interview candidates to manage the bar.

videos.title: Heist
videos.overview: An elaborate bank heist to steal a single safe deposit box held by Veronica Stephens, a Navy contractor, leads NCIS to investigate her corrupt consulting firm.

videos.title: Joyride
videos.overview: The NCIS team is joined by NCIS Special Agent Nicole DeChamps after a Marine reservist with a history of PTSD disappears following a drunk and disorderly altercation.

videos.title: The Sound of Silence
videos.overview: After the chief of logistics for a naval weapons station collapses on the job, the NCIS team must determine if this is a terror threat or a stress-induced breakdown. Also, Kensi and Deeks research different honeymoon locations.

videos.title: Better Angels
videos.overview: The NCIS team works with the Global Criminal Tribunal when a Syrian seeking justice, David Sarraf, is brutally attacked while delivering evidence that would prove chemical weapons were used on civilians. Also, Kensi stays at the crime scene and comforts Sarraf who is pinned behind a vehicle.

videos.title: Smokescreen (1)
videos.overview: The NCIS team partners with the FBI to locate a terrorist cell in Los Angeles believed to be preparing for an imminent attack.

videos.title: Smokescreen, Part II
videos.overview: As the team continues to search for a terrorist cell in Los Angeles, Callen and Sam remain trapped in a movie theater after multiple bombs have detonated and every remaining exit is wired with explosives.

videos.title: Into the Breach
videos.overview: The NCIS team investigates the murder of a journalist who was writing an exposé on a mishandled classified military operation. Also, as their wedding day quickly approaches, Kensi and Deeks work on the last remaining items on their to-do list.

videos.title: Till Death Do Us Part
videos.overview: After months of planning, the NCIS family celebrates the wedding of Kensi and Deeks. Also, an old acquaintance, Anatoli Kirkin, pays Deeks a surprise visit on his wedding day and he isn’t alone.

videos.title: Born to Run
videos.overview: Sydney turns to her sister Nell for help after her high school crush, Andre Martinez, is mixed up in a Russian plot to steal intelligence from the Department of Defense. Also, Special Prosecutor John Rogers conducts mandatory performance reviews with the team.

videos.title: Searching
videos.overview: Sam assists a Department of Justice agent with locating a former U.S. boarder patrol officer who disappeared after the cartel threatened him; Kensi partners with a special agent from the Criminal Investigative Department to recover a stolen hard drive with sensitive military information.

videos.title: Choke Point
videos.overview: After a Navy Seal is attacked while moonlighting at a security job for a successful marijuana dispensary, Sam personally vows to apprehend the suspect out of respect for the Navy Seal brotherhood

videos.title: The One That Got Away
videos.overview: After Anna Kolcheck escapes from prison with her cellmate, Callen and the NCIS team assist with the investigation and search for her whereabouts.

videos.title: No More Secrets
videos.overview: The NCIS team travels to Cuba for an unsanctioned mission after Callen gets a lead on Anna Kolcheck's (Bar Paly) whereabouts.

videos.title: The Guardian
videos.overview: Callen and Sam travel to the USS Allegiance in the Persian Gulf to work with Navy Captain Harmon "Harm" Rabb, Jr. (David James Elliott) when the NCIS team uncovers ISIS sympathizers who are targeting military locations.

videos.title: False Flag
videos.overview: Callen and Sam work with Navy Captain Harmon "Harm" Rabb, Jr. (David James Elliott) to locate a group of ISIS sympathizers aboard the USS Allegiance. Also, Hetty enlists her friend, Lieutenant Colonel Sarah "Mac". Mackenzie (Catherine Bell), to help obtain information from a Russian diplomat.

videos.title: Let Fate Decide
videos.overview: Callen and Sam work with Navy Capt. Harmon Rabb, Jr. to apprehend spies aboard the USS Allegiance. Also, Hetty partners with Marine Lt. Col. Sarah “Mac” Mackenzie to neutralize a missile attack in the Middle East, and Kensi and Deeks are trapped in a mobile CIA unit in Iraq while under attack by ISIS.

videos.title: Decoy
videos.overview: Faced with multiple cases worldwide, the NCIS team splits up, with Callen and Sam working with Mossad Agent Eliana Sapir in Tel Aviv, and Kensi partnering with DOJ Agent Lance Hamilton in Los Angeles.

videos.title: Hail Mary
videos.overview: Callen and Sam run protection detail for retired Navy Admiral Kilbride in an operation to locate a missing Naval intelligence officer.

videos.title: Yellow Jack
videos.overview: While Callen and Sam are aboard the USS Allegiance, the ship is placed under quarantine for possible Ebola exposure. Also, Kensi and Deeks investigate the murder of a petty officer who recently departed the USS Allegiance and is linked to the Ebola exposure.

videos.title: Provenance
videos.overview: The NCIS team searches for a stolen painting valued at $40 million after online chatter indicates the artwork is being sold on the black market to fund terrorist activity.

videos.title: A Bloody Brilliant Plan
videos.overview: The NCIS team reluctantly aligns with two former criminals from England, Ricky Dorsey and Frankie Bolton, after a powerful arms dealer kidnaps Ricky’s daughter in an attempt to obtain a dangerous weapons system.

videos.title: Concours d’Elegance
videos.overview: The NCIS team links the theft of an undersea drone prototype to a video game streamer’s elaborate party. Also, Callen and Sam cross paths again with insurance broker Katherine Casillas, who insures the gamer’s property and processions.

videos.title: Human Resources
videos.overview: After a Navy lieutenant disappears from the scene of a car accident, the NCIS team processes the crime scene and discovers his laptop is missing along with recently accessed confidential information for retired Navy SEALs.

videos.title: Kill Beale: Vol. 1
videos.overview: Callen and Sam travel to San Francisco to search for Beale after he's kidnapped during a clandestine mission for Hetty.

videos.title: Mother
videos.overview: Akhos Laos , a former black ops agent originally recruited and trained by Hetty Lange, returns to seek revenge on Hetty for the life she introduced him to, on the 250th episode

videos.title: Answers
videos.overview: While the team investigates the theft of a computer virus, Callen and Sam consider their future at the agency, Kensi and Deeks discuss having children, and Eric and Nell analyze the impact of Eric’s undercover assignment on their relationship. Also, the team tracks Mara a crooked upscale banker

videos.title: Groundwork
videos.overview: CIA Officer Veronica Stephens asks the team for help when an agricultural engineer Hetty asked her to bring to the United States disappears

videos.title: High Society
videos.overview: After a rise in deaths caused by black market opioid use, the NCIS team links the street drug to funding for terrorist activities

videos.title: Commitment Issues
videos.overview: The NCIS team investigates the murder of a Naval warfare engineer at a spoken poetry event. Also, Callen asks Nell to assist him in a worldwide search for Anna's whereabouts.

videos.title: The Circle
videos.overview: Anna Kolcheck returns to warn Callen that he is in danger and he must now work with an archenemy to stop an underground trafficking ring.

videos.title: Alsiyadun
videos.overview: When Fatima is captured while on a mission and held for ransom, Callen and Sam enlist a deep undercover CIA agent, Kadri, to help get her back.

videos.title: Watch Over Me
videos.overview: When an FBI agent is killed while trying to track the location of an undercover agent, NCIS must find the missing agent before the criminals he was investigating do

videos.title: Missing Time
videos.overview: While NCIS investigates the disappearance of a department of defense officer who was looking into a recent UFO sighting, Anna makes a bold decision about her future.

videos.title: Fortune Favors the Brave
videos.overview: While Sam investigates the murder of an Iranian exile working to overthrow the current regime, he must also try to save Agent Rountree, a new agent who’s having an unexpectedly adventurous first day on the job, when he accidentally triggers a bomb. Also, Nell makes a decision about her future with NCIS.

videos.title: Knock Down
videos.overview: The team assists the DOJ in the investigation of an arsonist who targets an FBI safe house that's protecting a political activist seeking asylum; Eric deals with the aftermath of Nell leaving the team.

videos.title: Murder of Crows
videos.overview: The team helps a former NCIS tech operator search for her missing ex-partner, whom they fear might be working with the gun runners they failed to take down years ago; Deeks reels when his bar gets a negative review.

videos.title: Code of Conduct
videos.overview: Sam, Callen and Rountree travel to Afghanistan when Marine Lieutenant Colonel Sarah "Mac" MacKenzie asks NCIS to help with a sensitive case after two SEALs claim their chief murdered an unarmed prisoner.

videos.title: The Bear
videos.overview: When a Russian bomber goes missing while flying over U.S. soil, Callen and Sam must track it down in the desert and secure its weapons and intel before the Russians on board destroy the plane. Meanwhile, Hetty gives Nell a cryptic assignment.

videos.title: War Crimes
videos.overview: As the trial begins of a Chief Petty Officer who Callen and Sam arrested for war crimes last year, the NCIS team is called to help find the missing star witness.

videos.title: Angry Karen
videos.overview: When Nell sends Sam to meet an informant who plans to blow the whistle on a military secret, Hanna's life is in danger when the man tries to run him down and kill him. Also, Kensi and Deeks debate whether or not to buy their first house.

videos.title: Cash Flow
videos.overview: The body of a murdered Navy reservist is found by thieves in the midst of a robbery and NCIS must work with the burglars to find the killer. Also, Kensi and Deeks struggle to decide if they are ready to make the leap and buy a house.

videos.title: Raising the Dead
videos.overview: In order to get intel on a matter of national security, Kensi must come face-to-face with a sociopath who has been obsessed with her since she put him in jail years ago. Also, though Deeks is desperate to keep Kensi safe, he is forced to leave NCIS.

videos.title: If The Fates Allow
videos.overview: Before Christmas, Hetty assigns Callen the case of his former foster brother and his wife who, upon reentry into the U.S., are framed for smuggling drugs across the border in her oxygen tanks. Also, Deeks is struggling with losing his job at NCIS.

videos.title: Overdue
videos.overview: The NCIS team's murder investigation of a man who sold military information leads to the abduction of a doctor whose cutting edge neurotechnology could be developed into advanced weaponry. Team members are interviewed by FLETC to see if Deeks would make a good NCIS agent. Callen tries to have an important talk with Arkady.

videos.title: Love Kills
videos.overview: When NCIS investigates the murder of a man about to reveal the source of a massive counterfeiting operation, an old acquaintance becomes their prime suspect and reveals the true reason for her return. Also, Deeks struggles during training to become an official NCIS agent

videos.title: A Fait Accompli
videos.overview: While NCIS must track down an organized crime leader who is trying to buy stolen defense technology, Callen goes to Anna to ask the ultimate question. Also, Deeks is kicked out of NCIS training only to find that Hetty has a life-changing surprise for him.

videos.title: The Frogman’s Daughter
videos.overview: When Sam’s daughter Kam is kidnapped after leading citywide protests he will stop at nothing to find her. Also  Deeks rejoins NCIS and Callen searches for answers about Anna

videos.title: Russia, Russia, Russia
videos.overview: When Callen goes to the National Counterterrorism Center on the pretext of interrogating a Russian asset from the crashed plane case he investigated months earlier, the tables are turned and he is detained, accused of being a Russian agent.

videos.title: Can't Take My Eyes Off You (I)
videos.overview: After Callen receives a cryptic message from Hetty, he tracks down the person tailing him, bringing him to a remote location teeming with Russians… and face to face with Anna.

videos.title: Red Rover, Red Rover (II)
videos.overview: To rescue Joelle from further torture by the Russians, Callen and NCIS must offer up Anna as bait to Katya. Also, Callen finally discovers who accused him of being a Russian spy.

videos.title: The Noble Maidens (III)
videos.overview: Callen and the team discover that Anna is being held by a group with ties to Anna's upbringing and must rescue her before she is forcibly returned to Russia. Also, Admiral Kilbride makes Nell a serious offer.

videos.title: Imposter Syndrome
videos.overview: NCIS obtains a hard drive containing a realistic deep fake video of a deceased terrorist and must retrieve the dangerous technology behind it. However, when the team’s comms are highjacked during their mission, they find that one of their own has been a victim of its potential.

videos.title: Signs of Change
videos.overview: When military grade technology is stolen, a deaf engineer, Sienna Marchione, who always wanted to serve her country, and the only member of her team to survive the theft, helps Kensi and NCIS track down the tech before it’s taken out of the country.

videos.title: Through the Looking Glass
videos.overview: When a Naval Intelligence Officer is tortured and murdered, NCIS must work with Joelle, who informs them that other CIA operatives are being killed in the same way. Also, Kensi receives a threatening postcard from David Kessler, the sociopath who is obsessed with her.

videos.title: A Tale of Two Igors
videos.overview: Deeks is kidnapped by an associate of Kirkin’s in need of his help and NCIS investigates the shooting of a militarized dolphin equipped with a Russian microchip. Also, Beale makes Nell an interesting offer and Hetty returns.

videos.title: Subject 17
videos.overview: While Callen suspects Hetty of keeping secrets about his past and Joelle surfaces in her quest to capture Katya, NCIS must track down an informant whose life is in danger. Also, Kensi and Deeks work to expand their family.

videos.title: Fukushu
videos.overview: NCIS takes the case personally when an LAPD officer’s father, a beloved elderly Japanese American veteran, is the victim of a vicious hate crime.

videos.title: Indentured
videos.overview: Sam and Kilbride clash when a case involving an arms dealer responsible for the slaughter of ATF agents leads them to a well-connected colonel and friend of Kilbride, accused of supplying militia groups with guns. Also, Kensi and Fatima go undercover at a rehab facility to question the arms dealer’s girlfriend.

videos.title: Sorry for Your Loss
videos.overview: As Callen continues hunting Katya, Kilbride enlists NCIS to help find a truckload of stolen guns. The assignment becomes more challenging when their suspect, the son of a mob boss they believe was planning to sell them, is found dead.

videos.title: Divided We Fall
videos.overview: When an NCIS mission to protect a compromised undercover agent goes completely sideways, the agents are individually interrogated to find out what really happened. Also, Kilbride must make a difficult decision.

videos.title: Sundown
videos.overview: Sam negotiates and Rountree goes undercover, when a man takes a busload of hostages and threatens to blow it up unless his daughter’s war crimes are posthumously cleared.

videos.title: Lost Soldier Down
videos.overview: NCIS investigates the apparent suicide of a Navy intelligence officer who leapt to his death after taking LSD. Also, while Kensi is away, Deeks makes plans to redo the backyard without her input.

videos.title: A Land of Wolves
videos.overview: The NCIS team scrambles to find Kensi, when she is attacked and kidnapped by a mysterious militia group while helping a group of migrants cross the border.

videos.title: Under the Influence
videos.overview: The NCIS team helps a U.S. ambassador search for her missing daughter, Gia, a popular social media influencer. Also, Agent Aliyah De León returns to support the team with the case.

videos.title: Where Loyalties Lie
videos.overview: When a civilian scientist working with the marines is killed, and her advanced radar technology stolen, the NCIS team must scramble to find the missing technology and the culprit.  Deeks worries about how to tell Callen that he's selling the bar.

videos.title: All the Little Things
videos.overview: When a newborn child is found abandoned on a Navy ship, Kensi and Deeks search for the mother on board before she dies of complications. Also, Nate meets with Admiral Kilbride and learns about the CIA project from the ‘70s and ‘80s involving children.

videos.title: Murmuration
videos.overview: The NCIS team investigates an unidentified aircraft that flies into U.S. airspace and crashes into a Navy plane. Also, Deeks and Kensi begin to prepare for their foster inspection.

videos.title: Bonafides
videos.overview: When DOJ Agent Lance Hamilton's partner is killed, Sam dons his previous undercover persona of "Switch" to find the culprit. Also, Kensi, Deeks, Rountree and Kilbride work to catch an aerospace engineer who stole classified Navy schematics.

videos.title: Pandora's Box
videos.overview: NCIS investigates the robbery of a high-end arts storage by going undercover as potential buyers on the black market, to find who is behind the stolen items.

videos.title: Perception
videos.overview: Rountree and his younger sister are pulled over by police and treated harshly in a clear case of racial profiling. Also, NCIS investigates the death of a Navy photographer who was assigned to document the building of a new weapons station.

videos.title: MWD
videos.overview: NCIS investigates the kidnapping of Master Sergeant Boomer, a military working dog. Also, Sam looks to sell his boat so he can take care of his father who is suffering from Alzheimer's.

videos.title: Genesis
videos.overview: The NCIS team helps Naval intelligence officer Akhil Ali locate a fellow officer who went missing while recruiting foreign assets as potential sources of intelligence. Also, Callen and psychologist Nate Getz track down a man Callen believes was present for his training when he was young.

videos.title: Hard For The Money
videos.overview: NCIS investigates the murder of a woman employed in the Navy’s missile defense program and its connection to stolen Navy missile technology. Also, a strict social worker stresses out Deeks, and Sam debates selling his boat.

videos.title: Live Free or Die Standing
videos.overview: The NCIS team works with DEA Agent Talia Del Campo to find a missing whistleblower set to testify against gun manufacturers marketing to drug cartels.

videos.title: Work & Family
videos.overview: NCIS investigates after two men are blown up by their own explosives while attempting to break into a military base. Also, Callen wants to take the next step with Anna, and Sam moves in with his father, Raymond.

videos.title: Down The Rabbit Hole
videos.overview: The NCIS team must quickly find Callen after he falls for Katya’s trap using Sam’s deepfake to coordinate a weapons deal.

videos.title: Come Together
videos.overview: The NCIS team hunts for a heist crew that robs a Los Angeles casino with military-grade power. Also, Kensi and Deeks hear exciting news regarding the adoption and Callen takes a big step in his relationship with Anna.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 21 wins & 24 nominations total
